title: Point-in-Time Snapshot Ledger for Injuries, Depth Charts & Inactives
problem: NFL.com overwrites weekly injury tables in place and removes players once placed on Injured Reserve (e.g., Lamar Jackson in Week 10), while club depth charts lag IR moves.
decision_improvement: Prevents lookahead leakage when backtesting originated lines and preserves exact pre-kickoff replacement certainty.
path_a: Path A (Lightweight): Scheduled GitHub Action archiving immutable timestamped JSON snapshots 3x/week plus T-85m pre-kickoff.
path_b: Path B (Institutional): Append-only PostgreSQL/Parquet event store reconciled against official licensed NFL data feeds.
prerequisites: Confirm NFL.com & club website terms of use or procure commercial feed license (see Q-02).

title: Interactive Offense vs. Defense Matchup Deficiency Matrix (1st–4th String)
problem: Raw alphabetical injury tables bury positional cascades (such as NE Ben Brown listed as 1st LG & 2nd C while Out, alongside backup T Walter Rouse DNP).
decision_improvement: Surfaces immediate trench and coverage mismatches (e.g., WR1 facing promoted 2nd/3rd-string CB, or EDGE1 facing 2nd/3rd-string OT/LG) on one screen.
path_a: Path A (Static Rule Engine): Flag positions where 1st-string is Out/DNP and 2nd/3rd-string is elevated using depth-chart rank rules.
path_b: Path B (Snap & NGS Weighted): Weight each missing starter by prior-4-week snap share and Next Gen Stats separation/pressure metrics.
prerequisites: Requires multi-source player ID mapping across nfl.com/injuries/, club depth charts, and 53-man rosters (see Q-05).

title: Vig-Free Market Consensus vs. Originated Fair-Line Decomposition View
problem: Comparing model win probabilities directly against raw bookmaker American odds (-110 / SGP prices) conflates model disagreement with operator hold.
decision_improvement: Separates true pricing divergence (origination alpha) from operator vig/margin before any bet structure is considered.
path_a: Path A (Benchmark Mode): Display originated fair probability alongside vig-stripped pinnacle/consensus benchmark probabilities.
path_b: Path B (Execution Mode): Integrate multi-book timestamped order-book limits, push probabilities on key numbers (3, 7), and SGP hold penalties.
prerequisites: Requires licensed historical & live sportsbook quote archive and jurisdiction clearance (see Q-01, Q-03).

title: Joint-Simulation Correlation Explorer with Confidence Intervals
problem: Point estimates of leg correlation (rho) in small NFL season samples (~272 regular-season games/year) carry wide sampling error and regime drift.
decision_improvement: Prevents originating parlays or player prop combos on spurious historical correlations by requiring lower-bound confidence edge.
path_a: Path A (Parametric Copula): Estimate shrunk empirical phi/Pearson correlations with game-clustered 95% confidence bounds.
path_b: Path B (Play-by-Play Monte Carlo): Simulate play-level drive states conditioned on pace, weather, and starter availability.
prerequisites: Requires aligned historical play-by-play and settled prop line archive (see Q-06, Q-07).

title: Pre-Registered Strategy Registry & Deflated Multiple-Testing Audit Log
problem: Testing dozens of feature combinations and promoting only the top backtest winner guarantees selection bias ('winner's curse') on a leaderboard.
decision_improvement: Forces every strategy trial—including failed parameter sweeps—into the denominator of False Discovery Rate (FDR) and Deflated Sharpe checks.
path_a: Path A (Git Commit Lock): Require immutable Git commit registration of strategy code and parameters prior to walk-forward scoring.
path_b: Path B (Automated CI Gatekeeper): Reject PRs to the leaderboard unless all 8 validation gates pass on locked holdout splits.
prerequisites: Requires agreement on minimum effective sample size and alpha threshold before first backtest run (see Q-08).

title: Two-Stage Skill Leaderboard (Proper-Score Qualification -> Prospective CLV/ROI Escrow)
problem: Rewarding raw short-term ROI allows high-variance longshot parlays to top a leaderboard purely by luck.
decision_improvement: Aligns incentives strictly with calibrated probabilistic skill (Brier Skill Score + Closing Line Value) over multi-week prospective samples.
path_a: Path A (Non-Monetary Research Credits): Award compute tiers and badge recognition based on prospective Brier Skill Score and CLV.
path_b: Path B (Escrowed Milestone Pool): Vest rewards across 8+ prospective NFL weeks only when post-gate p-value and drawdown rules hold.
prerequisites: Requires legal/compliance sign-off on competition reward structure in applicable jurisdictions (see Q-01, Q-09).

title: Stadium Roof/Surface & NWS Hourly Wind/Precipitation Overlay
problem: Outdoor passing efficiency and field-goal accuracy degrade non-linearly in high wind/precipitation, while retractable roofs lock 60–90 minutes pre-kickoff.
decision_improvement: Prevents totals and passing-prop mispricing by coupling NWS forecast grids with official 90-minute stadium roof designations.
path_a: Path A (NWS Grid Lookup): Map all 30 NFL US stadium lat/lon coordinates to api.weather.gov hourly forecast endpoints.
path_b: Path B (International + Roof Feed): Add international venue weather feeds (Munich/London/Madrid) plus T-90m roof-status parser.
prerequisites: Requires stadium coordinate registry and international weather source selection (see Q-10).

title: 2026 Kickoff & Declared Onside-Kick Regime Priors Filter
problem: Pooling 2018–2025 totals and drive-start averages blindly ignores 2026 Rulebook changes to kickoff setup zones (6-1-3), 50-yard touchbacks (6-1-5), and anytime onside kicks (6-1-6).
decision_improvement: Avoids systematic bias in originated game totals and 4th-quarter comeback win-probability curves.
path_a: Path A (Regime Indicator): Add season-regime fixed effects / exponential decay down-weighting pre-2026 special-teams plays.
path_b: Path B (Structural Drive Re-Weighting): Re-anchor starting field-position priors solely on 2026 Weeks 1–9 official play-by-play.
prerequisites: Requires 2026 play-by-play special-teams dataset verification (see Q-11).

title: Unified Root Navigation Bridging Parallel Session Workspaces
problem: Concurrent multi-agent work created separate directories (root pages, research-workspace/, dashboard/, decision-hub/) to respect non-overlapping file claims.
decision_improvement: Gives human reviewers a single canonical entry bar comparing all session audits without losing any session's verified evidence.
path_a: Path A (Top Switcher Banner): Add a lightweight workspace switcher bar across root index.html linking all 4 workspaces.
path_b: Path B (Canonical Merge): Consolidate verified datasets into one build pipeline after human review selects preferred UI.
prerequisites: Requires cross-session lock release or owner approval per COORDINATION.md.

title: Automated Official-Domain Allowlist & Empty-Cell Integrity Pre-Commit Hook
problem: Line-by-line repo review found placeholder links (GitHub Pages docs cited for betting jurisdictions) and secondary blog URLs in sibling workspaces.
decision_improvement: Guarantees every future commit enforces semantic domain-to-topic matching and blocks inferred fill-ins for missing data.
path_a: Path A (CI Check): Run decision-hub/scripts/verify_hub.py in GitHub Actions on every pull request.
path_b: Path B (Schema + HTTP Snapshot Check): Store SHA-256 content hashes and HTTP retrieval timestamps alongside every cited official URL.
prerequisites: Approve official domain allowlist policy (see Q-12).
